Tagora Bibi @ Tgara Bibi vs Unknown on 8 July, 2025
08.07.2025
Item no. 14
Court No.25
 Mujahid
 Crm (Db) 3445 of 2022

In Re: An Application for modification of order dated 03.11.2022
 in connection with Ranitala Police Station Case no. 245/2021
 dated 27.06.2021 under Sections 498A/302/34 of the Indian
 Penal Code.

And
 In the matter of : Tagora Bibi @ Tgara Bibi
 ......Appellant.
 Mr. Soumojit Das Mahapatra,
 ......for the Appellants.
 Mr. Atanu Ghosh
 ......for the State.
 In Re: Cran 1 of 2025
 1.
Present application has been moved for modification of order dated 3rd November, 2022 whereby
the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court taking into account the fact that a minor child ought not to
be kept in jail custody with the petitioner, directed that child be handed over to the parents and
other relations of the deceased mother, if they are willing to take care and custody of the child and
otherwise the child was directed to be kept in a home under the supervision of the Child Welfare
Committee.
2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the child presently is under the custody of Child Welfare Committee, Murshidabad.

Learned counsel submits that now the petitioner has been released on bail vide order dated 10th November, 2022 and, therefore, the petitioner who is grandmother of the child may be handed over the custody.
Let a report be called from the Child Welfare Committee, Murshidabad.
The child should be around now 6 years old.

The State shall ensure that a child physiologist interacts with the minor child and submit a report as to the Welfare Tagora Bibi @ Tgara Bibi vs Unknown on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171703598/
1 of the child.
